errors.NOTHING_TO_INVOICE: Everything fulfilled on this order is already invoiced.

errors.VALIDATION: Please check the values you entered.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.

messages.pending: Sent for approval. It takes effect once approved.
messages.confirmed: Payment confirmed and posted to the customer's account.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.overdueDays: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

issue.title: Issue invoice
issue.queueHelp: Fulfilled orders with quantity not yet invoiced. Partially fulfilled orders can be invoiced for what was delivered.
issue.uninvoiced: {count, plural, one {# unit to invoice} other {# units to invoice}}
issue.nothingToInvoice: This order has nothing left to invoice (not fulfilled yet, or already invoiced).
issue.days: {count, plural, =0 {Due on issue} one {# day} other {# days}}
issue.serverComputes: Prices, discounts and 14% VAT come from the order; the server computes every amount and the invoice number when you issue it. An issued invoice cannot be edited — corrections are credit notes.
issue.previous: Invoices already issued for this order

invoice.creditPending: A credit note of {amount} is waiting for approval.

credit.title: Request a credit note
credit.help: Credit returned or damaged quantities, or a goodwill amount. The server computes the credit with its VAT; a second person approves it before it reaches the customer's account.
credit.amountHelp: VAT is added at the invoice's rate.

check.empty: Enter a quantity for at least one line.
check.exceedsQty: A quantity is more than what can still be credited on that line.
check.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.

record.title: Record a payment
record.receivedAtHelp: Leave empty if you received it just now. It can only go back a few days, and never into a closed month.
record.verificationNote: Cash and cheques collected in the field wait for finance to verify them before they reach the customer's account.
record.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
record.invalidReceivedAt: The time received cannot be in the future.
record.noCustomers: You have no customers to record a payment for.

payment.recordedPending: Payment recorded. Finance will verify it.
payment.noAllocations: Not allocated to any invoice yet.

paymentActions.backdated: {count, plural, one {Recorded # day after it was received. Check the date before confirming.} other {Recorded # days after it was received. Check the date before confirming.}}

allocate.title: Allocate to invoices
allocate.noOpenInvoices: This customer has no open invoices.

check.empty: Enter an amount for at least one invoice.
check.exceedsInvoice: The amount for {invoice} is more than its open amount.
check.exceedsPayment: The total is more than the payment's unallocated amount.
check.exceedsLimit: The total is above your allocation limit.
check.unknownInvoice: An invoice is no longer open. Reload the page.

statement.title: Customer statement
statement.signNote: A positive balance is owed by the customer; a negative balance is a credit in the customer's favour. Amounts include VAT.

aging.title: Receivables aging
aging.help: Open invoices by days past their due date, today in Cairo. Tap an amount to see its invoices.

writeOff.title: Request a write-off
writeOff.help: Write off what the customer will not pay (e.g. a closed clinic). A second person approves it; only then is it posted to the customer's account. A fully written-off invoice stops reopening collection tasks.
writeOff.amount: Amount to write off, VAT included (EGP)
writeOff.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. clinic closed, handed to legal
writeOff.pending: A write-off of {amount} is waiting for approval.

check.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
check.exceedsOpen: The amount is more than what is still open ({open}).

print.invoiceFooter: Amounts in Egyptian pounds (EGP), VAT included where shown. Computer-generated document.
print.notApplied: Not yet applied to an invoice.
print.receiptFooter: Amounts in Egyptian pounds (EGP). This receipt is valid for confirmed payments only. Computer-generated document.
print.receiptUnavailable: Only a confirmed payment has a receipt. This payment is pending, bounced or reversed.
